summary: Protein-level resources can supply channel-family presence by clade (InterPro, UniProt 2026_03, OrthoDB at Metazoa level, 386 Ensembl Metazoa genomes). No source I found classifies channels as context-sensitive or codes body-plan complexity, and no ready presence/absence matrix across unicellular outgroups and early metazoa was found.
next_step: Define the channel families and context-sensitive criteria in advance, build the per-species matrix from OrthoDB or InterPro proteome counts including choanoflagellates, and take body-plan coding from a published source.
obstacles_confirmed: Body-plan complexity and context sensitivity are not fields in any resource I queried.
InterPro per-taxon distribution calls are slow and timed out in my test.
